description: This is a PHP controller class named LeaveRequestController within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling leave request viewing functionality. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes traits for leave request services and user role management. The preRender method checks access permissions and prepares components for rendering leave request details.

classes.name: LeaveRequestController
classes.description: Controller class handling the display logic for leave requests, including permission checks and component setup for the Vue-based frontend.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave request view by validating request parameters, checking user permissions, and setting up the Vue component with relevant leave request data.
